name: GAN16 MagLev MAX UV 3x3 (XuanYi Geng Dual-WR Edition)
description: Celebrate world-record-shattering speed with the GAN16 MagLev MAX UV 3x3 (Dual-WR Limited Edition)! Crafted to commemorate Team GAN’s superstar XuanYi Geng, this exclusive release honors his iconic 3x3 World Records — a 3.05s single (Shenyang Spring 2025) and the current World Record 3.84s average (Beijing Winter 2026).
